source_caption:
Tom Hiddleston got his role in Early Man (2018) because of a Robert De Niro impression.

Director Nick Park saw Hiddleston doing the impression on The Graham Norton Show and was so impressed that he cast him as Lord Nooth. His performance showed exactly the kind of voice and comedic talent Park was looking for.
-

Dir. Nick Park

source_details.title: Early Man
source_details.synopsis: Early Man is a 2018 stop motion animated sports comedy film directed by Nick Park, and written by Park, Mark Burton and James Higginson. It was produced by Aardman Animations, and stars the voices of Eddie Redmayne, Tom Hiddleston, Maisie Williams, and Timothy Spall. The film follows a tribe of primitive Stone Age valley dwellers who have to defend their land from bronze-equipped invaders in a football match. Early Man premiered on 20 January 2018 at the BFI Southbank cinema, and was released theatrically in the United Kingdom on 26 January 2018.
